comparison.objective: Commission a damper versus pack food and scented toiletries into a bear canister and lock its lid.
comparison.physical_skill: Recessed tool engagement and precise collar locking versus multi-object packing, lid placement, and quarter-turn closure.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe impact cycles and retained setting versus all four required items enclosed before the canister is locked.
comparison.reason: Shared closure/rotation primitives do not make the tasks equivalent; packing under an implicit inclusion rule tests different planning and manipulation. Exact containment tolerances are not supplied.
